scope: Selected manually observed macOS ARM64 print-preview and native print-to-PDF control of the locally generated, previously saved and independently audited skewed polygon IMAGE.
checks: The native print preview displayed the 18-vertex skewed image against the page, with the area outside the clip left white.

The native Print dialog saved one A4 color page as a scratch PDF. Poppler independently rendered its first page; visual inspection showed the skewed polygon and colored pixels, with white outside the clipped area. The PDF reports one unencrypted A4 page and Qt 6.12.0 as producer.
The scratch application uses a distinct settings organization and signed bundle. The drawing and PDF remain outside the repository; no DWG/DXF fixture was committed.
limits: One generated skewed, normal-clipping image and one macOS PDF workflow; this is not a physical-printer, dimensional-scale, inverse-clipping, edited, or other-platform qualification.
The drawing preview reported an invalid-scale message during initialization; no claim about scale accuracy is made.
No overall image-format or consumer-parity claim follows.
